title: Bayesian Sequential Trials for Adaptive Batching & KV Cache Recommendations
creator: Priya Nair
description: Run adaptive Bayesian sequential A/B experiments to validate automated batching size and KV cache prefetch recommendations. Goal: reduce per-token cost while protecting latency SLOs and model output quality. This ticket covers experiment design, telemetry, statistical stopping rules, dashboards, and safe apply/rollback playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Bayesian sequential engine implemented with documented priors and stopping rules
Primary and safety metrics instrumented end-to-end and visible in the experiment dashboards
Deterministic policy recommendation produced for >=3 production cohorts with confidence levels
Rollback hooks defined and tested for latency and quality regressions
Experiment runbook and postmortem template published and reviewed by PM and SRE
experiment_design: Three cohorts stratified by request token distribution: short (<64 tokens), medium (64-512), long (>512). Each cohort: control (current heuristics) vs treatment (recommendation engine). Start at 1% traffic per arm and ramp to 10% over 72 hours if safety gates pass. Bayesian sequential checks every 6 hours. Decision rule: promote if posterior probability(cost reduction > 10% AND p99 latency increase < 2%) > 0.95. Early stop for futility if posterior P(cost reduction < 5%) > 0.9.
metrics: Primary safety: p99 token latency and tail latency (95th and 99th)
Quality guardrail: LM output regression rate on fixed prompt set (pass/fail)
Throughput: requests/sec and GPU utilization per shard
analysis_plan: Use a Bayesian hierarchical model to borrow strength across cohorts while allowing cohort-level heterogeneity. Produce posterior distributions for cost delta and latency delta; compute posterior probabilities for decision thresholds and expected loss under asymmetric loss (penalize latency regressions heavily). Quality evaluated as posterior probability of regression rate increase > 1%. Export daily snapshots and final summary CSVs for dashboard ingestion.
dashboards: exp/bayes-batch-cache/overview: time-series of cost delta, latency delta, posterior probabilities
exp/bayes-batch-cache/quality: per-prompt failure rates and example diffs
oper/experiment-runbook: live traffic split, safety gate status, and rollout controls
rollout_plan: If treatment meets decision rule for a cohort, recommend staged rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 7 days with daily safety checks. For Dedicated customers, create recommendation PR and require manual opt-in. For Hosted customers, auto-apply only when posterior probability > 0.99 and no safety violations in prior 48h. Each apply must create an automatic rollback ticket.
rollback_criteria: Immediate rollback if p99 latency increases > 5% absolute or > 10% relative vs control for two consecutive 5-minute windows
Rollback if posterior probability that quality error rate increased by > 1% exceeds 0.95
Manual rollback for unexplained GPU OOMs or >3x baseline API error rate
